plugins.name: neev-sdk
plugins.description: The NeevCloud SDK skill lets your agent create sandboxes from TypeScript or Python, write files, run commands and long-running processes, expose a port to get a public preview URL, and control what the sandbox can reach on the network.

plugins.name: neev-cli
plugins.description: The NeevCloud CLI skill lets your agent install and sign in to neev-cli, choose an organization and project, manage the sandbox lifecycle, and run files, commands, and processes inside a sandbox from a shell or CI.
